title: Active text perception for mobile robots
summary: 宽视野扫描发现稳定文字候选，再递归云台居中/变焦；报告了文字识别增益。

mechanisms.name: Active text perception for mobile robots — l10:9 route mechanism
mechanisms.description: 宽视野扫描发现稳定文字候选，再递归云台居中/变焦；报告了文字识别增益。
inputs: wide-field camera observations with stable text candidates
matched action-execution receipts and comparable observation outcomes
outputs: camera-relative recenter, zoom, or rescan action
mechanisms.limitations: 云台室内机器人、静态文字；没有目标语义绑定、身体靠近、到达或交接。
